content: {"paper_id":"W2154455818","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"semi-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"We consider the general problem of learning from labeled and unlabeled data, which is often called semi-supervised learning or transductive inference.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确研究从有标注和未标注数据学习，并称其为半监督学习/转导推断，符合半监督学习设定。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-manifold-regularization","exact_quote":"A principled approach to semi-supervised learning is to design a classifying function which is sufficiently smooth with respect to the intrinsic structure collectively revealed by known labeled and unlabeled points.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要要求分类函数对由有标注与未标注点共同揭示的内在结构足够光滑，即用数据几何结构施加一致性约束，符合图/流形正则化。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
